dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 30, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: June 1st**

The Chicago White Sox dominated the Baltimore Orioles 9-3 behind a strong team effort and standout performances from Andrew Benintendi (2 hits) and Junior Perez (1 HR, 3 RBI). Erick Fedde earned the win, while Tyler Schweitzer secured the save.

In other games, the Texas Rangers edged the Cleveland Guardians 4-2 with Jacob deGrom dealing 7 innings of 2-run ball and 9 strikeouts. Joc Pederson hit a home run and 2 RBIs to lead the Rangers. Josh Jung also hit a home run for the Rangers.

The Philadelphia Phillies crushed the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-0, led by Trea Turner's 2 hits and 3 RBIs, including a home run. Cristopher Sánchez pitched 7 shutout innings with 9 strikeouts.

The Detroit Tigers took down the New York Yankees 9-3, with Tarik Skubal allowing just 1 run over 6 innings and striking out 9. Riley Greene hit 2 home runs and 3 RBIs to lead the Tigers.

The New York Mets shut out the Toronto Blue Jays 3-0, with Nolan McLean pitching 6 shutout innings and striking out 7. Luis Torrens hit a home run for the Mets.

The Washington Nationals routed the Boston Red Sox 8-1, with Cade Cavalli pitching 7 scoreless innings and striking out 13. CJ Abrams hit a home run and 1 RBI for the Nationals.

The St. Louis Cardinals edged the Atlanta Braves 5-3, with Matthew Liberatore pitching 5 scoreless innings and striking out 9. Nathan Church hit a home run and 3 RBIs for the Cardinals.

The Tampa Bay Rays defeated the Kansas City Royals 10-4, with Bobby Witt Jr. hitting 2 home runs and 3 RBIs for the Royals. Griffin Jax earned the win for the Rays.

The Milwaukee Brewers topped the Cincinnati Reds 7-2, with Brandon Sproat pitching 5.1 scoreless innings and striking out 7. Sal Stewart hit a home run and 2 RBIs for the Brewers.

The Chicago Cubs outlasted the San Diego Padres 9-7, with Dansby Swanson hitting 2 home runs and 3 RBIs for the Cubs. Fernando Tatis Jr. hit a home run for the Padres.

The Houston Astros edged the Minnesota Twins 6-4, with Yordan Alvarez hitting a home run and 4 RBIs for the Astros. Josh Bell doubled for the Twins.

The Miami Marlins crushed the Colorado Rockies 14-3, with Eury Perez pitching 5.1 scoreless innings and striking out 8. Javier Sanoja hit a home run and 3 RBIs for the Marlins.

The Los Angeles Dodgers defeated the Athletics 9-3, with Justin Wrobleski pitching 7 scoreless innings and striking out 11. Tommy Edman hit 4 hits and 4 RBIs for the Dodgers.

The Seattle Mariners topped the Los Angeles Angels 8-3, with José Soriano pitching 5 scoreless innings and striking out 9. Colt Emerson hit 3 hits and 2 RBIs for the Mariners.

The Arizona Diamondbacks routed the San Francisco Giants 8-2, with Ketel Marte hitting a home run and 3 RBIs for the Diamondbacks.
